title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

You will have the chance to guide and continuously improve the ways in which they engage, educate, and empower people around the world, combining the best of human touch and technology scale, exploring the use of everything from the latest generative AI models to blended and immersive environments, multi-modal and varied-form content, and the most innovative research and teaching methodologies.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS)
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.

  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;

  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD

Desejável

  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!


Role Description

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack Sênior (PHP E VUE)
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue Sr , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.

PJ

100% home office


Sobre a Posição:

Buscamos um desenvolvedor Full Stack experiente e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia, focado na manutenção e evolução de sistema legado de alta demanda. O profissional ideal deve ter uma mentalidade orientada a soluções e disposição para trabalhar tanto com tecnologias frontend modernas e legadas quanto com diferentes versões do PHP em um ambiente tecnológico heterogêneo.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Backend

Sólida experiência com PHP, incluindo domínio das versões 5.6 e 7.0;

Proficiência em MySQL 5.6, incluindo otimização de queries e performance;

Experiência com Docker e containerização;

Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

Conhecimento desejável em Google Cloud Platform .


- Frontend

Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas;

Domínio de JavaScript;

Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

Conhecimento de HTML5 e CSS3;

Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Principais atividades:

- Manter e aprimorar sistema legado de alto tráfego;

- Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando Vue.js;

- Realizar a manutenção de códigos legados em jQuery;

- Implementar melhorias de performance e segurança;

- Realizar refatorações estratégicas mantendo a estabilidade do sistema;

- Colaborar na modernização gradual do código frontend e backend;

- Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico;

- Documentar alterações e processos técnicos;

- Mentor técnico para desenvolvedores menos experientes.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimento em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo.

O candidato ideal deve ser capaz de equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Principal Project Manager Fast response Team
description:
T-Systems, a German multinational company belonging to the Deutsche Telekom Group, is looking for a highly experienced Principal Project Manager to join our Fast Response Team , supporting critical projects and services that require rapid stabilization and recovery.


This team plays a key role in safeguarding complex global projects, ensuring they return to the right track while rebuilding customer confidence.

• Plan and manage projects in a highly complex global IT environment

• Highly proactive, structured and results-oriented mindset


Languages


• German – Business fluent

If you are passionate about leading complex IT programs, solving critical project situations and working in an international environment, we would love to hear from you!

title: Data & Transportation Analyst - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Analista de Tesouraria Jr (Crédito e Cobrança)
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:


  • Avaliar, com suporte e orientação, crédito para novos clientes, através do levantamento e análise de documentações, referências comerciais e informações financeiras dos clientes (ex. balanço patrimonial, DRE e fluxo de caixa), visando assegurar uma avaliação consistente e evitar inadimplência.
  • Realizar a classificação de risco de crédito (rating), validar com seu superior imediato, recomendar limites de crédito e encaminhar para análise da seguradora.
  • Analisar limites de crédito definido pela seguradora e inserir a validação de liberação de crédito no cadastro dos clientes.
  • Emitir Relatório de Rating dos clientes.
  • Realizar o processo para revisão de limite de crédito para os clientes e validar junto ao seu superior imediato.
  • Acompanhar e analisar status de ordens bloqueadas para faturamento, a fim de identificar e avaliar as informações que estejam impactando na liberação, bem como atuar nas ações necessárias para desbloqueio.
  • Realizar o processo de cobrança junto a clientes inadimplentes, negociando a regularização dos títulos em aberto.


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e sistemas de análise de crédito (ex.: relatórios Serasa, balanço financeiro) que permite avaliar e analisar riscos de crédito;
  • Conhecimento das técnicas de cobrança, técnicas de negociação e em matemática financeira (ex.: cálculos de juros/encargos, projeções de crédito e caixa);
  • Vivência em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA, para vaga temporária(licença maternidade);
  • Diferencial: experiência com o sistema SAP.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.

  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.

  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.

  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.

Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.

  • Salesforce certifications.

description:
Job Title: Electro-Mechanical CAD & Design Automation Engineer

Location: Remote

Job Type: Freelance / Contract – Flexible Hours

Job Overview

We are looking for Mechanical, Electro-Mechanical, and Mechatronics Engineers with experience in CAD tools and Python-based design automation to support advanced AI-driven engineering data generation projects.

In this role, you will work on 3D CAD model generation, geometry validation, and design workflow documentation to help create high-quality engineering datasets used for training AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA, Creo, NX, or FreeCAD
  • Understanding of 3D file formats such as STEP/STP and STL
  • Familiarity with geometry validation or CAD model comparison
  • Basic knowledge of Python scripting for CAD automation is preferred

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Python CAD libraries such as build123d, CadQuery, or OpenCascade
  • Familiarity with EDA tools (KiCad, Altium, OrCAD, etc.)
  • Experience documenting engineering workflows or recording technical processes

Benefits

  • Remote & flexible work
  • Work on advanced AI-driven CAD tasks
  • Earn up to $70 per hour of audit-accepted recording

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply using the form below:

description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: QA/QC Manager – Data Centers
description:
The Client


Datacenter People is working with the largest building commissioning and operational risk management providers in the world.


What the Job Involves…

  • Actively supports the Company’s commitment to safety and its core values.
  • Performs quality inspections in accordance with program quality control documentation. Participate and guide project quality control from kick-off until hand-off.
  • Provides oversight of the implementation of the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinates the quality inspections with the site sub-contractors and vendors.
  • Coordinates with the customers representative on all quality matters.
  • Provides oversight in the distribution of relevant QA/QC documentation to site subcontractors while reviewing that completed documentation is stored appropriately upon completion.
  • Verifies that the quality related site activities are in accordance with the design documents and program standards.
  • Participates in the internal and external site audits.
  • Coordinates all the quality site inspections through the Contractor QC team.
  • Ensures all quality control documentation is compiled and competed for as-built hand over through the Contractor QC team.
  • Provide review and reporting of all non-conformance reports and undertake remedial action. Monitors the implementation of the approved site QC Plan.
  • Completes and coordinates the approval of the sites QC technical submittals to the customer.
  • Coordinates with the Client and Contractor QA/QC team on all quality issues.
  • Coordinate and chair the QA/QC site weekly meetings with the Contractor QC personnel.
  • Assures all technical documents relative to site quality control are of current status.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Data center commissioning/QA experience.
  • Has a Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline preferred.
  • Has Certifications in Lean, Six Sigma, Quality Auditor, and/or Quality Engineer a plus.
  • Is experienced with ISO 9001 certification process.
  • Has a history and experience driving improved Quality at scale.
  • Is able to work seamlessly across functional and department lines.
  • Has experience with standard data center equipment to include: electrical distribution equipment from switchgear to panelboards, VFDs, low voltage power and moulded case circuit breakers, overhead IT busway, Diesel Generators, DX units, air handlers, water treatment equipment, BMS modules, and hot aisle containment accessories.
  • Is able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.


We regret that due to the high volume of applications we are unable to acknowledge each one. Please bear in mind that if you are selected for interview we will contact you within the next seven days.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Media Tech Support
description:
Work Mode: Remote

Location: Costa Rica / Mexico / Brazil


Role Overview

We are seeking a Media Tech Support professional to support file-based media workflows in a dynamic and global environment.

This role is responsible for handling support requests, collaborating with engineering teams to resolve issues, validating solutions, and maintaining accurate technical documentation.

The ideal candidate is highly self-sufficient, capable of working independently, and committed to delivering high-quality support and excellent customer experience. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts are essential.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for media technology support issues
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to transcoding, automated QC, and content delivery
  • Maintain and support media encoding and transcoding platforms, ensuring performance and reliability
  • Work with cloud infrastructure, including compute, storage, and networking
  • Create and maintain documentation, including runbooks and escalation procedures
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and document solutions
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement fixes and improvements


Required Skills & Experience

Media & Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of video, audio, and timed text within a content supply chain
  • Knowledge of media containers (MOV, MXF, MP4, MPEG-TS)
  • Familiarity with video codecs (H.264, H.265/HEVC, ProRes, MPEG-2) and audio codecs (AAC, AC3, EAC3, BWF)
  • Understanding of frame rates, resolutions, scan types, and color spaces

Systems & Tools

  • Experience with Linux and Windows Server
  • Familiarity with Jira and Slack
  • Experience working in customer support or service-oriented environments
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills

Automation & Integration

  • Experience manipulating video, audio, and subtitles via APIs, JSON, or command line
  • Proficiency in creating or modifying JSON/XML workflows for transcoding and QC
  • Understanding of API protocols

Cloud

  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Ability to operate and test systems in cloud-based environments (Linux/Windows instances)

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities
  • Ability to work in high-pressure, fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud-based transcoding systems
  • Knowledge of AWS architecture and Well-Architected Framework
  • Scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Perl, or Ruby)
  • Experience with subtitle and caption formats (SRT, VTT, IMSC, TTML, etc.)
  • Familiarity with IMF, Dolby Vision, or Dolby Atmos
  • Knowledge of shared storage systems (NAS or object storage)
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Experience working with global teams


Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience or equivalent academic experience in media workflows
  • Technical certifications are a plus

title: Scrum Master
description:
Se você gosta de desafios, almeja estar numa empresa que vai além de bites e bytes, abraça,resolve os problemas dos clientes e ainda ofereça ambiente acolhedor, a Groundwork é o local ideal para você!


Estamos buscando um Scrum Master altamente motivado e experiente para liderar nossas equipes de desenvolvimento ágil. O candidato ideal terá profundo conhecimento das metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum, e será responsável por garantir a aplicação eficaz das práticas ágeis em nossos projetos. Como Scrum Master, você será o facilitador-chave das cerimônias ágeis, garantindo que a equipe esteja alinhada com os objetivos do projeto, removendo impedimentos e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Além disso, você será responsável por orientar e capacitar a equipe em práticas ágeis, promovendo a melhoria contínua e o sucesso do projeto.

Responsabilidades:

  • Facilitar as cerimônias ágeis, incluindo reuniões de planejamento de sprint, revisões de sprint e retrospectivas.
  • Ajudar a equipe a compreender e adotar os princípios e práticas ágeis.
  • Identificar e remover impedimentos que possam afetar a produtividade da equipe.
  • Colaborar com o Product Owner e outras partes interessadas para garantir a entrega contínua de valor ao cliente.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Fomentar a cultura de melhoria contínua e aprendizado dentro da equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as melhores práticas ágeis e tendências do setor.

Requisitos:

  • Certificação Scrum Master: PSMI - Professional Scrum Master ou CSM – Certified Scrum Master;
  • Profundo conhecimento das metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, facilitação e resolução de problemas;
  • Experiência em projetos de Plataformas Digitais, Dados e Inteligência Artificial;
  • Capacidade de influenciar e motivar equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Formação acadêmica em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada.



O que oferecemos?

  • Contrato PJ (pessoa jurídica);
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Wellhub;
  • Auxílio em certificações e treinamentos;
  • Ajuda de custo com cursos de idiomas;
  • Plataformas de treinamentos on-line;
  • Presente de aniversário;
  • Presente nascimento de filho;
  • Presente casamento;
  • Kit boas-vindas.

A Groundwork

Somos construtores tecnológicos, uma empresa ágil, moderna e eficiente, qualidades estas, vistas em nossa busca pela EXCELÊNCIA de entrega.

Almejamos um mundo tecnológico descomplicado e conectado, de tal forma natural, que uma sociedade possa evoluir em conjunto com sua tecnologia.

Trabalhamos por meio de nossos VALORES em respeito ao próximo e ao meio ambiente, colaboração, ética, seriedade e honestidade, pois tecnologia não é feita somente de bits e bytes.

title: Partner Success Executive - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Partner Success Executive position focuses on managing relationships with Senior Advisors - senior referral partners committed to generating leads through introductions. This role involves ensuring advisors achieve their lead goals through effective time management, process execution, and relationship building while maintaining engagement cadence, tracking performance metrics, and optimizing targeting strategies to drive high-quality introductions and conversions.


Key responsibilities


- Onboarding new Senior Advisors by establishing clear expectations around introductions, engagement cadence, and performance metrics.

- Providing ongoing support to advisors as the primary point of contact, maintaining structured 1:1 meetings to track pipeline and engagement, guiding targeting strategy and ideal prospect profiles, and monitoring performance metrics.

- Managing introductions and lead generation by qualifying prospects before engagement, connecting with introduced prospects in a timely and professional manner, managing follow-up cadence through conversion or disqualification, and handing off qualified leads to Sales Operations with proper documentation.

- Driving advisor engagement by maintaining motivation and retention, facilitating participation in advisory tasks, events, and networking initiatives, collecting structured feedback to improve program design, and ensuring positive experience and long-term program loyalty.

- Providing feedback to advisors on introduction quality and outcomes while optimizing targeting based on conversion data.

title: Backend Developer (Python +Golang +GCP)/ 100% Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Profile: Backend Developer (Python +Golang +GCP)

Job Type: Long-time based contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil.


Job Description:


8+ years of software development experience , with 4–5+ years working with Golang and Python in backend systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Golang and Python .
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs following standard REST design principles.
  • Develop scalable solutions using microservices, SOA, and distributed architectures .
  • Apply object-oriented and functional programming paradigms in system design.
  • Implement and follow SOLID principles and software engineering best practices.
  • Design and architect scalable, highly available, and reliable systems .
  • Work with cloud platforms (GCP) to deploy and manage applications.
  • Build and manage cloud-native solutions using services like compute, storage, networking, and managed databases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions .
  • Identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in code and database queries.
  • Design and manage complex data models and persistent storage systems .
  • Take ownership of technical roadmaps and architecture decisions .
  • Monitor and maintain production systems , ensuring high availability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root-cause analysis .
  • Implement observability tools (logging, monitoring, tracing) for system visibility.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership and guidance .

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

description:

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Job Title: Java Developer

Location: Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica

Work Mode: Remote

Employment Type: Contract


Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer to join a dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Java 8+ , relevant frameworks (Spring, Hibernate ), relational databases, RESTful APIs, version control, and basic frontend knowledge. This role requires problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Responsibilities

  • Develop applications using Java 8+ and frameworks like Spring and Hibernate .
  • Apply strong object-oriented programming (OOP) principles.
  • Work with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL , and write optimized queries.
  • Build, maintain, and consume RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Use version control tools like Git for collaboration and code management.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React .
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications.
  • Work with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence for task and project tracking.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and a dynamic work environment.
  • Communicate effectively with teams and stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Java 8+ and frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, etc. )
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
  • Experience with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs and web services
  • Experience with version control tools (Git)
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React )
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence
  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly in a dynamic environment


Desirable Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies
  • Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Strong collaboration in cross-functional and remote teams


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in a relevant field
  • Technical certifications related to Java development are highly recommended

title: Diretor(a) de Arte - Júnior
description:
Código da vaga: 58873


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei #fera em direção de arte, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • 3 anos de experiência prévia em agência de publicidade , marketing ou design.
  • Experiência comprovada com desdobramentos de mídia digital (adaptação de peças para diferentes formatos e canais).
  • Experiência com criação e desdobramento de e-mails /peças de e-mail marketing (CRM).
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator e similares) e Figma.
  • Conhecimento dos principais formatos e especificações de mídia digital (dimensões, pesos, boas práticas).
  • Domínio de composição, tipografia e tratamento de imagens, garantindo consistência visual.
  • Bom senso estético e atenção a detalhes de acabamento e padronização.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de cumprir prazos com autonomia.
  • Acompanhar tendências e boas práticas do mercado digital e de design.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa, com postura proativa e criativa.
  • Demonstrar abertura para aprender e contribuir de forma parceira no time.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
